invariants_never_to_break: No autonomous application submission (ADR-0016). Stage 22 is blocked by design.
No sensitive demographic attribute may reach matching, scoring, ranking or recommendation (ADR-0007).
No unlawful data acquisition: no CAPTCHA bypass, access-control circumvention or fingerprint evasion (ADR-0008).
Never run npm audit fix --force: it leaves Payload's peer range (ADR-0017).
Never skip, disable or delete a test to obtain a green run.
No integration described above its recorded status in INTEGRATION_REGISTER.md.

RLS: set tenancy with set_config(name, value, true) inside the query's transaction; FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY on every policied table; never guard on IS NULL alone — a recycled connection reports the empty string. Proven in tests/rls-isolation.test.ts, recorded as R-33.
Never print, log or commit DATABASE_URL / DIRECT_URL; diagnostics use describeDatabaseUrl() only.
Every new table is classified in src/lib/tenancy/rls-tables.ts and the RLS migration regenerated; the coverage test enforces it.
User-facing queries run inside requireTenant().run(tx => …); a db. call inside a run callback escapes the transaction and is a defect.
prisma migrate deploy is the only production migration path; db push is local prototyping only.
DATABASE_URL and DIRECT_URL authenticate as the SAME role: the system RLS policy is bound to the migration role; a different application role sees nothing.

Every model-backed task goes through src/lib/ai/gateway.ts: the tenant's AI policy is resolved before dispatch, RESTRICTED fields are refused, the deterministic engine always runs, output is grounded in code before render, and an AiRun row records the route and the exact prompt version. Nothing else may import the SDK or an external provider (static test).
A prompt version serves traffic only as PromptVersion.deploymentStatus = default, reached only through promote, which refuses unless evaluationStatus = passed. Never set default by hand.
Approved evidence is immutable (service + database trigger); a correction is a new version.

No taxonomy dataset is loaded except through requireIngestible(): the dataset's licence must be recorded and ingestion approved by an admin, with the attribution text the product displays (ADR-0009, SOURCE_ACCESS_POLICY.md). Never flip TaxonomyDataset.licenceStatus or ingestionApproved by hand.

No job source runs except through requireEnabledSource(): the JobSource row must be enabled, its per-connector record complete (legal basis, terms review, approval, retention) and its named credentials present (ADR-0008, SOURCE_ACCESS_POLICY.md). Never flip JobSource.status by hand.
A JobSnapshot is never updated (database trigger); the Job Folder's 'exactly what the posting said' depends on it.
An AtsRuleset carries no evasion setting: pacing is standard or human_delay (ADR-0008). Never reintroduce a stealth option.
